svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Print lying on its board face, with support under the 6 mm of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top tab that stands out on that side. Spine 48 x 3 x 158 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top tab 48 x 18 x 4 mm across the top of the spine, with two 3.2 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes 18 mm each side of centre, 6 mm out on the board side:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M3 screws up through these (before the board goes on) into

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the two M3 x 20 standoffs that hang it from the top plug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clip face (dashed in the front view), from the top: two clips for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 16 mm capacitor, 8 and 30 mm down; a 22 x 10 x 50 mm pocket

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: open at the top; at the bottom, two clips for the C cell, 10 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm up from the bottom edge. Clips wrap about 200 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board face: four 2.5 mm pilot holes for the board standoffs,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 mm apart across and 100 mm apart down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the cell and capacitor snap into their clips.

svg.text: Check: it slides into the tube with 2.5 mm to spare all round.
